title: A Rivergate for the Provision
author: B. M. Villalobos
blurb: Freya Zhou, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
